draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.35, the 32nd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 4th of 22 at LB. He went 19th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Kiko Alonso. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (89th percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 3rd in tackles among the 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 56 career games and 37 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-5 off-ball linebacker who played: 3 combined tackles against a median of 66, below the norm.
